title: Colony Life: Structures, Roles, and Scale

sets.relationshipLabel: A chamber and the item it is kept for
sets.explanation: Each chamber exists to hold a specific kind of item: nurseries shelter eggs, granaries store seed.

sets.relationshipLabel: A collection and the kind of member that makes it up
sets.explanation: A colony is defined by its workers just as a swarm is defined by its alates, each collection named for its typical member.

sets.relationshipLabel: A worker role and the substance its work is centered on
sets.explanation: A scout's labor revolves around pheromone signals just as a forager's revolves around honeydew, tying each role to its defining substance.

sets.relationshipLabel: The same kind of path or passage, minor scale versus major scale
sets.explanation: A trail scales up into a highway just as a tunnel scales up into a catacomb, each pair showing the same passage at two sizes.
